title: PLANIMETRIC
subtitle: Held frames — locked-off depth planes where background routine and deviation meet
lineage: Primary: SCION 086 (Songs from the Second Floor) · Supporting: SCION 085 (Jeanne Dielman), SCION 089 (Wes Anderson / Yeoman)
theorem: Select fixed, planimetric views of rooms and workspaces with practical activities at different depths. Hold the frame while foreground and background tasks interact and a small route change alters the arrangement, without cutting to a rescuing close-up.
boundary_note: Static, centered, and planimetric are distinct constraints; original archival camera behavior is preserved without artificial pan-and-scan.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #02 (t=03.50s-14.00s): `8d2b2cbb` (`Long Distance`, 1941) cuts internally at t=05.5s from switchboard operators to 1940s trucks on a highway.
Seg #05 (t=32.00s-42.00s): `8d2b2cbb` at in_s=14.0s dissolves across forest linemen, a close-up operator, and a moving bus.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: The primary constraint of `PLANIMETRIC`—a sustained, locked-off fixed view of a room without camera movement or cuts—was violated by internal montage cuts in `8d2b2cbb`.
critic_tribunal.causal_hypothesis: `Long Distance` (`8d2b2cbb`) is a promotional montage with cuts every 2-3 seconds.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Replace Seg #02 and Seg #05 with Cineosis human-verified locked-off planimetric room shots: `79565922` (`Working Together`, 1951, `10.2s-19.7s` in Seg #02 and `19.7s-28.4s` in Seg #05, showing the same frontal conference room as posture and table geometry shift across time), paired with `3533825c` (`White Ammunition`, 1942 workshop) and `780c159d` (`Success in Business`, `0.5s-10.0s`, locked-off frontal room tableau).
critic_tribunal.strength_to_preserve: Tableau 02 (`3533825c`, `White Ammunition`, 1942) and the locked-off conference room tableau (`79565922`, `Working Together`, 1951).
